method: Directly read and semantically interpreted each numbered frozen original line 241–400 in order; machine inventories, previous V1 and automated scans credited zero

semantic_interpretation_segments.interpretation: Closes prior Admin queue decision and locks simple default equipment setup plus optional remembered additional setups.
Each shot must retain immutable equipment setup/version snapshot, not reinterpret old shots after configuration changes.
Dose required; last actual dose for same coffee+setup takes precedence over setup Usual Dose.
Yield required but must start blank for each new shot, preventing accidental reuse.
Time required and must start blank; do not infer a time from style windows.
Actual grind required; prefill only same coffee+setup+style actual, otherwise blank.
Suggested grind is distinct from actual; explicit Use Recommendation copies suggestion and records provenance.
Optional temperature prefill follows exact-style actual then other-style actual for same coffee/setup; otherwise blank.
Suggested temperature is separate, opt-in to copy; deviation does not trigger automatic judgment.
Recommendation remains visible for user confirmation even if user enters a different actual.
Successful recipe must derive robust range/window and centerpoint from repeated evidence, not one magical value.
Materially different successful recipe families remain separate; do not average across styles/families.
Prior successful alternates remain accessible with current recipe prominent and alternates collapsed.
Taste preferences can select among distinct valid families; line320 closes prior object.
Historical experiment meaningful-change thresholds: dose 0.5g, yield 5g, time 5s, temp 2C/~4F, adaptive grind or style; later scoped Locked supersessions control.
Any single qualifying threshold is sufficient to offer, not automatically begin, an experiment.
Experiment prompt comes after rating, not during shot entry; preserves fast Log Shot flow.
Explicit user confirmation is required before creating an experiment workspace.
Subtle Experiment badge/panel differentiates candidate from established recipe without overwriting established state.
Subsequent shots remain associated with active experiment until explicitly ended or promoted.
First green materially different shot creates candidate; second successful repeat confirms alternate.
Owner can promote candidate as current after first successful shot, separate from two-shot confirmation.
Failed experiment ending returns to prior preferred recipe, retaining historical shot evidence.
Successful nonpreferred green experiment remains valid and Community eligible even when user reverts preference.
Remove rigid automatic styleFromNumbers reclassification; respect intentional shot style.
Style ranges are guidelines/reference points, not mandatory validity bounds.
Begins next Locked style decision; its content continues after line400 and is not yet credited.

current_counterpart.disposition: Apply current explicit owner supersessions; engine/shot UI runtime and authenticated persistence not exercised.

findings: Historical thresholds and style guidance require explicit later supersession mapping; do not treat this frozen baseline as current runtime proof.
Equipment snapshots, blank yield/time, separate suggestions, experiments and successful recipe families are preservation requirements; no current defect established.
